overview: This paper proposes a memory-efficient training pipeline for Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) that combines layer-wise gradient checkpointing with lossless spike compression, along with adaptive checkpoint structure adjustment and a memory-efficient LIF kernel, to reduce memory footprint without accuracy loss.

modules.name: Spike Compression and Decompression Engine
modules.description: Handles the lossless encoding and decoding of binary spike tensors. Implements bit-packing logic to compress floating-point spikes into bit representations and custom Triton kernels for high-speed compression and decompression operations.

modules.name: Memory-Efficient LIF (MELIF) Kernel
modules.description: Implements the Leaky Integrate-and-Fire neuron model using custom Triton kernels. Optimizes memory by reconstructing output spikes during the backward pass from stored membrane potentials rather than storing them explicitly, replacing standard CuPy/PyTorch implementations.

modules.name: Layer-wise Gradient Checkpointing Core
modules.description: Implements the fundamental gradient checkpointing mechanism for spiking layers. Discards intermediate internal states (membrane potentials) during the forward pass and recomputes them locally during the backward pass using stored inputs and weights.

modules.name: Spatial Segment Partitioning Strategy
modules.description: Implements the logic to identify memory-critical gradient checkpointing segments and split them along the layer/spatial dimension into subsegments. This recursively reduces the peak memory required for internal state storage.

modules.name: Temporal Segment Partitioning Strategy
modules.description: Implements the logic to split critical gradient checkpointing segments along the time axis into sequential chunks. Manages the propagation of hidden states (membrane potentials) between temporal subsegments while trading off temporal parallelism for memory savings.

modules.name: Greedy Segment Restoration Strategy
modules.description: Implements an optimization pass that iterates through gradient checkpointing segments and greedily reverts non-critical segments (those not affecting the global peak memory) back to standard BPTT mode. This minimizes recomputation overhead and recovers training speed.

modules.name: Automatic Pipeline Orchestrator
modules.description: The main control module that profiles the model's memory usage, identifies critical layers, and automatically applies the appropriate combination of optimization strategies (O1-O4). Wraps the model to restructure the computation flow with minimal user configuration.

modules.name: Neuromorphic Data Processing Pipeline
modules.description: Handles data loading, preprocessing, and augmentation for sequential and event-based datasets (e.g., CIFAR10-DVS, DVS128 Gesture, Sequential CIFAR-10). Includes specific transforms like frame integration, Neuromorphic Data Augmentation (NDA), and temporal slicing.

modules.name: SNN Training Loop Controller
modules.description: Manages the modified training loop required for the checkpointing mechanism. Controls the separation of forward passes with and without autograd, handles the manual triggering of spike decompression and state recomputation, and manages gradient computation and parameter updates.

modules.name: Efficiency and Performance Evaluator
modules.description: Tracks and calculates key evaluation metrics including peak GPU memory allocation, training throughput (samples/second), and validation accuracy. Provides functionality to compare these metrics across different optimization levels and against baseline BPTT implementations.
